text:
This policy of refusing parents or other relatives of A5 visa holders has absolutely nothing to do with stopping illegal immigration! It is not aimed at those relatives.
 It is aimed squarely at the couples themselves, with one brutal purpose: to make the whole process so exhausting, so degrading, and so infuriating that they break, give up, and walk away from both the process and the country.

And the worst part is that it works. Even worse, every time these stories are blasted around, it only does PIBA’s job for them—people see what’s happening and decide not to step into this shit at all.

When I see newcomers here asking how to get started or looking for advice, I just want to scream: Read the stories in this group! Think twice about whether you really want to go through this. Consider every possible alternative first!
